data.one_liner: Laravel-style query builder, schema builder, and migrations for PostgreSQL and MySQL.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Laravel-inspired query builder, schema builder, and migrations for Dart supporting PostgreSQL and MySQL drivers. Includes both a traditional query builder and an Active Record/Data Mapper ORM without code generation or reflection.
use_when: You want Laravel-style query building and migrations in Dart
You are connecting directly to PostgreSQL or MySQL databases
You want an ORM that does not rely on code generation or reflection
avoid_when: You need an embedded client-side local database like SQLite
You do not use PostgreSQL or MySQL
strengths: Rich query builder ported from Laravel 5.2 and 12
Supports multiple PostgreSQL drivers and MySQL
Active Record and Data Mapper ORM features without code generation
weaknesses: Limited to PostgreSQL and MySQL drivers
Not an embedded local mobile database like SQLite
data.setup_notes: Requires database connection configuration and proper driver setup for PostgreSQL or MySQL.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose drift if you prefer a reactive, type-safe SQLite database library with broad local storage support.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose sqflite if you need lightweight SQLite database access for mobile platforms.
